notes: Monthly plans roll month to month with 30 days’ notice to cancel.
Annual plans are paid up front and work out cheaper per month.
Drop-in classes are ₹500. Your first session is always free.

faqs.question: What happens in the free session?
faqs.answer: You meet a coach for about an hour. They show you around, ask what you want from training, watch you move through a few basic lifts and suggest where to start. There is no pressure to sign up on the day.

faqs.question: I have never lifted before. Is that a problem?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Most members start in Strength foundations, a four-week beginner block with groups of six or fewer. You learn every lift from scratch.

faqs.question: Can I freeze my membership?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every plan can be frozen for up to two months a year, for travel, injury or anything else. Tell the front desk a week ahead.

faqs.question: Can I change plans later?
faqs.answer: You can move between monthly plans at the start of any billing month. Annual plans can be upgraded at any time, and we credit what is left.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Comfortable clothes, flat shoes if you have them, and a water bottle. We provide chalk, belts and everything else.
